name: iter_freeze_scarce
description: LAYER-FREEZING PERSPECTIVE, scarce-pool setting (deficit 0.98, sigma 0.15, initial set 30): does freezing the first layer preserve or blunt the scarcity victory? The frozen features were learned on a training set whose gap region was withheld, so the features themselves may lack resolution exactly where the harvest lands. K=8, 15 seeds.
